annotations.exact_quote: Hyperspectral image (HSI) classification plays a critical role in numerous remote sensing applications
annotations.reason_zh: 论文以高光谱图像（HSI）分类为研究对象，摘要首句明确处理高光谱图像。

annotations.exact_quote: we propose a DR strategy with class prototypes to alleviate the problem of class imbalance
annotations.reason_zh: 论文显式针对类别不平衡，提出动态重采样与类原型策略缓解该问题。

annotations.exact_quote: we introduce a smoothing PLL loss and a mutual-entropy loss for more precise and reliable label disambiguation
annotations.reason_zh: 论文在部分标记设定下研究标签歧义，并设计PLL损失与互熵损失进行标签消歧。

annotations.exact_quote: real-world hyperspectral data usually exhibit both label ambiguity and class imbalance, posing a challenge to the algorithmic robustness of hyperspectral classification under partially labeled settings
annotations.reason_zh: 部分标记与标签歧义属于候选歧义的不精确监督，论文将该弱监督条件作为核心研究问题。
